title: Shell handling
question: How long does a Needlejaw need to take a Shellglider?
intervention: Watch the Needlejaw beside the Shellglider. Tap the Needlejaw: the inspector shows how many seconds of contact it has and how many it needs.
predictedTradeoff: A shell makes the Needlejaw hold on for 4 s before it can eat; a hunter that spends that long on one meal catches less in the same time.
confounds: This is a test fixture: a test-only override sets both species' speed to 0 so their contact never breaks. In an ordinary dish both move, contact can break and the count starts again. This is one run.

all.label: No capture before 4 s of contact
